pages.summary: Removed engine-contributor guidance and the obsolete command-dispatch discussion. Corrected the item construction example to resolve item keys, documented the fake's client-backend limit, and marked the inline example as uncompiled.
Reorganized transaction behavior into commit, rollback, storage coverage, authority and lifecycle sections. Preserved the direct-write rollback warning and documented the invalid-seal log message.

Corrected Wasmtime's stack limit to 128 MiB and distinguished it from the guest shadow stack. Removed internal regression-test and scanner instructions, rebuild history, and the extension-design link; documented mixed-target dependency refusal as behavior.
